card.line: Salem is a city whose name means peace. It was ruled by Melchizedek, priest of God Most High, and is often thought to be Jerusalem.

moments.title: Melchizedek blesses Abram
moments.text: Melchizedek, king of Salem and priest of God Most High, brought out bread and wine and blessed Abram. Abram gave him a tenth of everything.

moments.title: God's tent in Salem
moments.text: A psalm says God's tent is in Salem and His dwelling place is in Zion. There He shattered the weapons of war.

moments.title: King of righteousness and peace
moments.text: Hebrews says Melchizedek was king of Salem and priest of God Most High. His title means king of peace, and Jesus is a high priest in his order.
